ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-03-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Mishae Santalucia was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor Antoine Thomas Davis, Jr., who was also present at today's hearing.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Jamarion Tony Santalucia.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-22-2008 Reset To Jun-03-08 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Mishae Santalucia was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor, Antoine Thomas Davis, Jr., who was also present at today's hearing.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in file.

Petitioner did not have a valid Proof of Service re: notification of minor's father of the proposed name change of minor.
Good cause appearing, the Order to Show Cause for Change of Name the Minor is continued to June 3, 2008 at 9:00 a.m. in Department 218. No further publication or notice to the minor's father is required.

Reissued Order to Show Cause for Change of Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
